description: Extract restaurant menu items, popular dishes, photos, and external menu links from any Google Maps place page.

language.description: Interface language for the Google Maps UI.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Maximum number of menu items to extract (1-100000). Google may expose fewer inline menu cards.
maxItems.title: Max Items

placeId.description: Canonical Google Place ID beginning with ChIJ. Use this instead of placeUrl when available.
placeId.title: Google Place ID

placeUrl.description: Google Maps URL of the restaurant whose menu should be scraped. Copy from the address bar after opening the place on Google Maps.
placeUrl.title: Place URL

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings (optional). The scraper works reliably without a proxy by default.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Google Maps Menu Scraper
